summary: QMRT Simulation Lab merge/split lineage display feature testing completed. All 9 features tested and verified working. Fixed a bug where timeline scrubber navigation was not working due to incorrect property name (result.timeline vs result.measurements).
critical_code_review_comments: Fixed bug: navigateToStructure function was using result.timeline which doesn't exist - changed to result.measurements
Structure Time Tracking section correctly displays Births, Deaths, Merges, Splits counts
Lineage section appears in inspector when structure has parent_ids or child_ids
Event Type badges correctly show 'Merged', 'Split', 'Merged Into', 'Split From'
Event Time displays @ T = [time] when merge/split occurred
Parent/Child buttons have correct data-testid attributes (lineage-parent-{id}, lineage-child-{id})
Click-through navigation works - clicking parent/child button navigates to that structure
Timeline scrubber now correctly jumps to birth time of selected structure after fix

success_rate.backend: 100% (API returns correct merge/split data with parent_ids and child_ids)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Lineage display feature fully tested. Key testids: lineage-parent-{id}, lineage-child-{id}. Inspector panel shows TIME TRACKING section with status, birth/last_seen times, and LINEAGE section with event type badge and parent/child buttons. Timeline scrubber navigation now works correctly after fix.

structure_time_tracking_section.details: Shows Births (219), Deaths (184), Merges (49), Splits (42), Avg Life (0.26) in Fields tab

click_structure_marker_opens_inspector.details: Clicking SVG polygon/circle markers on heatmaps opens inspector panel

lineage_section_appears.details: Lineage section appears when structure has parent_ids or child_ids

parents_display_with_details.details: Parents shown with ID, time range (birth → last_seen), and status badge (merged)

children_display_with_details.details: Children shown with ID, time range (birth → last_seen), and status badge (disappeared)

event_type_badge.details: Event Type badge shows 'Merged', 'Split', 'Merged Into', 'Split From' with correct colors (cyan for merge, orange for split)

event_time_display.details: Event Time displays @ T = [time] when merge/split occurred

click_through_navigation.details: Clicking parent/child button navigates to that structure and shows toast notification

timeline_scrubber_jumps_to_birth_time.details: After fix, timeline scrubber correctly jumps to birth time of selected structure (e.g., t=0.00 → t=0.40)

bug_fixed.issue: navigateToStructure function was checking result.timeline which doesn't exist in API response
bug_fixed.fix: Changed result.timeline to result.measurements to correctly find timeline index for birth time navigation
